page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "eas". No marginal notes, no running head, no page number. Show-through of the reverse page sits faintly below the text and is left out.

main_text.l: ptios &c. v. 26. Quô facto reversum est mare primo diluculo
ad robur suum & fugerunt Ægyptij in occursum ejus &c. v.27.
Reversum dicitur mane הבקר לפנות i. e. advertente se vel im-
minente diluculo. ut ערב לפנות advertente se, vel adveniente
vesper à Gen.24.63. R.S. לעת שהבקר פונה לבא [?] tempore quo
diluculum apparere incipit. Haud abs re est, quòd Scri-
ptura circumstantiam hanc illucescentis diei primo ma-
nè subnotatam voluit. Hactenus quid rerum gereretur no-
ctis caligo non permittebat Ægyptios fieri conscios, nunc
illucescens dies, quid fieret omnium oculis exponebat,
& sic evidens fuisse miraculum spectantibus & pereunti-
bus ostendit Scriptura. Reversa dicitur aqua לאיתן [?] vox,
quae substantivè rem asperam notat, ut Gen.49.24. Sedet
באיתן [?] in aspero & arduo arcus ejus. Unde de torrentibus a-
quarum cum rumore labentium usurpatur Psal. 74. 15.
Amos 5.24. Chald. ferè vertit per תוקפא [?] robur, vigorem.
Significatur autem, aquas hactenus virtute divina repres-
sias & praeter naturam suam proprijs terminis contineri
coactas pristinum robur suum & vigorem nactas in al-
veum solito cum impetu descendisse, sublato quasi im-
pedimento, quo antea coercitae insolito modo stabant.
Baal Hatturim ingeniosè scil. observat, in voce לאיתן
esse אותיות לתנאו וכו [?] literas vocis לתנאו [?] (quae pacisci significat)

l.i: quia Deus pactus sit cum mari in prima creatione, ut sc.dehisceret

main_text.l: Israelitis suo tempore. Hanc esse intentionem figmenti illi-
us de decem rebus vesperâ Sabbathi creatis, quas refert
& explicat Caphtor Vaphaerach fol.54.1. ex Talmude in Pe-
sachim cap. 4. f. 54.1. Docet author Cosri. part. 3. §. 73.
Volunt nimirum Deum cum creaturis ita pactum esse,
ut retentâ naturâ suâ & ordinario operandi modo, certis
temporibus, quoties quidem miracula operari pararet,
eas

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-free page apart from the Hebrew words, which are copied as far as legible. Doubtful Hebrew marked [?]: the phrase after "Sedet"-line word לבא on the Gen. 63 line (לעת שהבקר פונה), the word after "aqua" (לאיתן), the Aramaic תוקפא, the word in the Baal Hatturim line (אותיות לתנאו וכו) and לתנאו after "literas vocis". The initial "ptios &c. v.26." is a fragment from the top of the page, kept as printed. "ut sc.dehisceret" is printed with a joined "sc." and a stop. Printing errors left as printed: "Vaphaerach", "Cosri". Show-through "Nostrum" below the text is omitted.
